verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a consumer authentication app, since any end-user app could ship an assistant or voice-command interface, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only tap, biometric, PIN, QR-scan and number-matching interactions, with no natural-language, chat or voice command capability. The probes also found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
